name: 2+D Pen-and-Ink for Volume Visualization
definition: A method where 2D strokes are generated based on 3D information associated with original 3D objects, treating isosurfaces as opaque objects for image buffer generation.
summary: 2+D Pen-and-Ink Rendering is a non-photorealistic technique that generates 2D strokes from 3D geometric data by decoupling analysis from rendering via post-processing image buffers.
